mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.name, u.email FROM user_identities identity JOIN users u ON u.id = identity.user_id WHERE identity.issuer = #{issuer} AND identity.subject = #{subject}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (id, name, email) VALUES (#{id}, #{description.name}, #{description.email})
INSERT INTO user_identities (id, user_id, issuer, subject, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{issuer}, #{subject}, #{createdAt})
INSERT INTO users (id, name, email) VALUES (#{id}, #{description.name}, #{description.email}) ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING
